changes: First release. The audio engine leaves out work that cannot change the sound, so the same pattern uses less CPU and the screen and keys answer faster under load.
Nothing to set. CPU shows in the lower right corner of the screen when the audio load is close to its limit, and OVR when it is over.
The output is stock's, but for one thing: a delay or reverb that has died away below -114 dBFS and has no input is given exact silence.
Known limits: OS 1.74 only; tested on one unit beside 17 other modules; a project load while sound rings and long USB audio streams are not tested yet.
